p1_appeal: Honoured Cabal, a fair verdict: my first plea was as plain as a gas receipt. Since then I bought in with my own imdTEST too. I still ask to sell 100,000 PLEA, 4% of my bag, to pay my gas; the rest stays and keeps playing the seasons. Thank you for reading me twice.
p2_plea: To the Cabal, with respect: I bought PLEA after the launch hour and the fees already put me in the red. I ask to sell 80,000, about 3% of my bag, to fund my next pleas. Not a dump, just a small cut to keep the lights on. The other 97% stays with me.
p3_letter: Dear judges, a letter from a holder of one afternoon. I took the airdrop at the open and bought a little more after. I ask to sell a fifth of my PLEA: gas does not take IOUs and my wallet is thirsty. Four fifths stay put, and I will keep writing to you.
p4_site: Your honours, I ask to sell 130,000 PLEA, under 5% of my bag, and let any stranger deliver it for the tip, since I trust strangers more than my own reflexes. I bought today and sit at a loss after the fees; this pays my gas. The rest stays for the seasons.
